systematic flows comprising of SIPs and STPs, that is systematic 
transfer plans, stood at INR48 billion in September, up 6% year-on-year 
across 19 million transactions.

quarter and also launched the Category III fund, investing in listed 
securities, which achieved first close during the last quarter. We have 
started managing EPFO fixed income mandate during the quarter that 
went by.

INR9.1 billion, up 16% with an operating margin of 36 basis points of 
AUM. Profit before tax stood at INR9.8 billion, up 12%.
